name: CaseStudySummary
description: Decision-first case study summary: outcome, role, constraints, key decisions and evidence with source labels.

ariaRequirements: section is labelled by its h2 via aria-labelledby
key decisions render as an ordered list

outcome.description: What changed because of the work, in one or two sentences.

role.description: Role and scope of the engagement.

decisions.description: The decisions that shaped the result.

evidence.description: Claims with an explicit source label; nothing is presented unsourced.

title.description: Section heading. Defaults to the translated "At a glance".

className.description: Additional class name applied to the section root.

forbiddenUse: present a claim without a source label
invent metrics that are not on record
dense: decision-first case study lead: outcome, role, constraints, ordered key decisions, evidence with source labels

usage.description: Opens a work case study before the process narrative, answering what changed, who did what, what made it hard, which decisions shaped it and where each claim comes from.
